notes.title: Balance hotfix: Lotara Sarrin
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/14fd508b214e60b8b61916164ddb79f3f932f6d7.jpg
"This is New Kershal all over again. Disengage!"
– Lotara Sarrin

Lotara returned to the battlefields of the Horus Heresy in force, and her initial performance sounded all of the alarms. Even though we have seen in the past how new cards and Warlords have achieved higher-than-average win rates while the meta reacts and players learn how to counter the new challengers, Lotara became a force to be reckoned with. This created a frustrating ladder to take part in, and a repetitive and tiresome competitive environment.

For this reason, today we are releasing an emergency balance hotfix addressing the situation and tweaking the main offenders of Lotara's ranked dominance:

IMPERIAL ARMY
● Lotara Sarrin: Changed Savage ability to 'Give Flank to adjacent troops' (it no longer buffs adjacent troops)

MECHANICUM
● Glaividian Ursarax: Increased ability cost from 0 to 1 and changed ability to '(1) Stun a random enemy troop' (instead of a random enemy).

These changes are now live in the game. We will continue to monitor the situation, as well as monitor the rest of the meta in preparation for the next balance update, currently scheduled for the first full week of the next competitive season.

notes.title: The Nights Lords are ready to haunt the battlefield
notes.content:
"Night falls. The hunt begins."
– Konrad Curze

AVE DOMINUS NOX
At the end of light, the shadows grow only larger. The macabre hosts of Konrad Curze are ready to bring the night to the battlefields of the Horus Heresy! The Hidden Dagger expansion for Warhammer Horus Heresy: Legions begins with the release of the new Night Lords collection, featuring fresh new artwork and game mechanics perfect for the murderous VIII Legion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/37743070b31f12fbd7ef17b381081be96919e5e8.jpg

NIGHT LORDS WARLORDS
Many Night Lords warriors engulfed the Galaxy in terror, but among them, three of their mightiest heroes were chosen to lead the Legion into battle:

Kheron Ophion: Possessing a sense of honour rare among his Legion, his shield is a constant reminder of his greatest failure.
Sevatar: Arrogant, ruthless and utterly infamous, Sevatar is a living avatar of the VIII Legion’s dark purpose.
Konrad Curze: The feared Primarch of the Night Lords, who brought judgment rather than deliverance to the worlds he claimed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/f2344d122ccadd815be7cbefdb7ca738cf9544f7.jpg

EVISCERATE ENEMY LINES WITH BRUTAL ACTS OF VIOLENCE
The Night Lords do not perform clean kills. Their sadistic souls seek to punish their prey with physical and psychological methods before making an example out of any poor soul that stands in their way. Their new Murder trait befits these blood-soaked killers, triggering an effect after defeating an enemy if the damage they dealt in the killing blow is superior to the poor victim’s remaining health.

Unlike Battle Honour, Murder will still trigger even if the troop with Murder dies while attacking. Murder is also not troop-exclusive and can be found on Tactics. Plan your attacks carefully and exploit their new mechanic to get as much value as possible out of your troops!

notes.title: Galaxy in Flames: Wave IV release
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/200f2af6079fb1f526b80fa7b16ead8b537f53a7.jpg
"How do you rank in the chain of command?"
– Saul Niborran

While the bloodiest of fighting was done by the Legiones Astartes, the bulk of the war was waged by the Imperial Army, Mechanicum and traitor elements. Millions fought against once comrades, while allied forge worlds tore each other apart, and Chaos cults sprung up on hundreds of loyalist worlds. 

Take a look at how to collect the cards from the fourth wave and at the new event in the latest blog post.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/eeede1a491daf3c32e5f9e1499012261d4be4e5d.jpg

NEW CARDS FOR THE NEUTRAL FACTIONS
For the more human elements of the loyalist and traitor forces, the war continued as it ever did. Countless Imperial Army contingents were sent to numerous warzones to fight for either Horus or the Emperor. The Mechanicum was decisively split in twain, with half following the original teachings of the Omnissiah and staying loyal to the Emperor and new Fabricator-General, while the other half turned to embrace the warp and techno-heresy, employing forbidden sciences to bolster their forces. Chaos cults and daemons manifested with more liberty than ever before, as where discord and ruin went, the forces of the Archenemy were never too far behind.

Twenty new cards are added for the neutral factions to bolster either their own decks or be added to Legions as a way of supporting the Astartes’ own wars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/74cd4b003218189176e554fe095f14612ecf83f9.jpg

HOW TO COLLECT THE NEW CARDS
Complement your deck and complete your collection with the new cards from the fourth wave. There are multiple ways to collect them:

notes.title: The Sisters of Silence scour the battlefield
notes.content:

"Only in silence, one can hear the Truth."

The Sisters of Silence confront the Immaterium and the invisible forces that conspire against the Imperium as they join the game in the Siege of Terra expansion. Lead the Silent Sisterhood and hunt the witch for the Imperium!

New faction: Sisters of Silence
Hard to perceive, clad in Vratine, fast and skilled warriors, the Sisters of Silence have always been fearful opponents whenever they arrive to the battlefield. Their unique status as blanks makes them essentially impervious to the powers of the Warp, and that transforms them into the greatest psyker hunters in the Imperium. Their presence in Prospero's Censure Host was no coincidence, and it will be key once again in Terra if the loyalists expect to defeat the traitor's onslaught.

Sisters of Silence warlords
Three collectable Warlords lead the Silent Sisterhood as they prepare to hunt the witch:

Amendera Kendel: An unparalleled psyker hunter who went on to become Malcador's Agentia Tertius.
Varonika Sulath: High ranking member of the Sisterhood. She oversaw the implementation of the Unspoken Sanction.
Jenetia Krole: Great leader of the Silent Sisterhood, who became one of the Emperor's personal battle confidantes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/fab994a8bbe7bccff3ef8332af028989d76c4bd9.jpg

Each reward crate in the 'Battle of Somnus Citadel' event has at least 1 Sisters of Silence card.
Sisters of Silence crates in the shop have at least 3 Sisters of Silence cards, 1 of them rare of better.
A constructed deck in the shop, with Amendera Kendel as warlord and an exclusive card back. Any duplicates you receive are converted into gems.
Cards for sale with gems in the Daily Shop.
VIP subscribers will find 1 guaranteed Sisters of Silence card in their Daily Mission crate during the 'Battle of Somnus Citadel' event.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34699872/1783248a82934c979b0d35ed5e4d72e0977a7c86.jpg

New event: 'Battle of Somnus Citadel'
The first event of the Sisters of Silence tests them against the forces of Chaos that invaded the Somnus Citadel. At the start of the Heresy, the Sisters of Silence took in refugees from the Death Guard in the Somnus Citadel, their headquarters on Luna. Unfortunately Solun Decius, one of these survivors, gave in to Nurgle and started a warp infestation inside the citadel. Which side will you fight for in this battle? Will you aid the Sisters of Silence or the daemonic forces of Nurgle?

The Sisters of Silence are now live. Take control of the Silent Sisterhood and scour the battlefield!

notes.title: The Imperial Fists stand ready to defend Terra
notes.content:
"None shall pass."
– Rogal Dorn, Primarch

The Imperial Fists lead the defenses of the Imperium as the first faction in the Siege of Terra expansion. Take control of the VIIth Legion and fend off the shadows of treachery!

New faction: Imperial Fists
After conquering and fortifying many worlds for the Imperium during the Great Crusade, the Emperor called the Imperial Fists back to Terra, and trusted them with the construction of the Imperial Palace’s defensive systems. Rogal Dorn and his sons accepted this task dutifully, and became the Emperor’s Praetorians. Their mission was vital to the survival of the Imperium, for these defensive system would be well-tested as the Horus Heresy raged on.

Alexis Polux: A brave captain of great strength who possessed a rational and supremely logical mind.
Sigismund: Considered by many the greatest warrior of the Imperium beneath the Primarchs.
Rogal Dorn: Primarch of the Imperial Fists. A brave and unyielding commander who never takes a step back.

The first event of the Siege of Terra expansion introduces the Imperial Fists testing the defensive systems of the Imperial Palace. They will do so during a Legio Custodes Blood Game, a military exercise in which a Custodes would attempt to infiltrate the Palace. Who will you join in this exercise to harden Terra's defenses? "It is my duty to pass on what I've learned to others."
– Sanakht

Update v1.4.4 is out with some major improvements to how decks can be shared! You can now share them in the Lodge and Global chats, or copy them to your clipboard and share them anywhere, in a readable text format that can be automatically imported by other players.

How to share a deck:
1) In Cards, click the eye icon next to the deck's name to open the full-deck view.
2) The 'share' button on the top right corner offers three options: share to Lodge, to Global chat, or to clipboard.
3) Once copied to clipboard, you can paste the deck in a readable text format anywhere you like.
4) To import a deck, go to Cards -> Change deck, click on the notepad icon and paste the text.
5) You need to own the warlord to import a deck. Any cards not owned will be highlighted and need to be replaced.

Will you share your battle wisdom, or keep the secret to yourself?

notes.content:
The Prospero expansion is about to begin, and it brings more than just new cards. Take a look at the new features and improvements included in the latest update, available to download now:

Share Match Replays and Decks with your Lodge
A much requested feature is finally here! Use the new 'Share' button in the Battle Log to share replays in your Lodge chat.
In addition, you can now share decks with your Lodge, either to show your deck-building skills or to ask for advice. Use the eye icon from the Deck editing menu to see your full deck, and then the new 'share' button to send it to your Lodge chat. Please note that, if you make further changes to the deck after sharing it, other Lodge members who press the link will see the most up to date version.

Improved Collection View
See which cards you own from each faction in a single view in your Collection, to make it easier to take a screenshot and share it when asking for deck-building advice. From your Collection, press the new list icon at the top right of the screen to activate this view.

Warlord Chats in Collection
You can now listen to all Warlord chats from the Collection. Go to any Warlord and find the chat icon to listen to their 6 combat chats, even if you haven't collected them all yet.

Improved Match Replays Controls
Review your match replays with improved controls: 
-> 'Pause' will now stop any actions queued from pressing the 'Next' button.
-> Advancing with 'Next' will now speed up some animations to move forward faster.

Support for 4:3 screen ratio 
The game now supports an increased range of screen formats, in full screen or windowed mode, up to 4:3 screen ratio.

notes.title: Minor update brings volume control and fixes
notes.content:
Listen to the cacophony of war! 
– Marius Vairosean, first Noise Marine

A minor update has been released with a number of fixes and improvements to make for a smoother experience while playing. You will find handling cards in your hand and in the deck menu easier, see more Lodges to join and be able set the volume for music and sound. Even more improvements will keep coming over time.

This update keep the version number at 1.3.1, to maintain cross-platform compatibility with mobile devices. Mobile players will get volume sliders in the next update.

Detailed changes:
● Add volume bars for music and sound effects.
● Synchronize all achievements with Steam, including those gained on mobile.
● Remember windowed/full screen mode between sessions.
● Improve handling of cards in hand.
● Add a few onboarding tips to Cards menu. 
● Remove special Alpha Legion sounds from troops in other legions.
● Fix error leaving card displayed when editing deck.
● Fix ‘Exit game’ popup not working on some menus.
● Fix text of tips in Russian not displayed correctly.
● Fix number of open lodges displayed in list.
● Fix selecting some lodge flags.
● Fix many other small under-the-hood issues.

notes.content:
“Our enemies may rest but rust never sleeps.”
A minor update has gone live! It improves the performance at the start of a session and streamlines the mouse controls based on player feedback. A single left-click will now show a troop’s description in battle and in the deck list. Right-clicking on a card in the deck list will remove it from the deck.
By the Omnissiah!
